panel.noRoots: Tell Easy CI where your projects live (for example ~/Developer): it will find all your clones and link them to their repositories automatically.

panel.noCiFiles: No {{config}} file in this folder or on the remote branch.
panel.consentNote: Easy CI never sends anything without your consent: CI files are modified in this folder, committed on a local branch, then pushed and proposed as a pull request only when you click "Push" and "Create". Automatic update, if enabled, only moves the branch forward when no local change is in progress.

connect.headline:
Your CI/CD pipelines,
finally under control.
connect.intro: Connect GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket to automatically detect your repositories' pipelines and follow every run live. You can add the other platforms later.
connect.privacy: Credentials are stored in your system's secure keychain and only sent to the platform they belong to.
connect.guideDescription: Create a token, choose its scopes and sign in.

form.hostHint: gitlab.com or the address of your self-managed GitLab.
form.bitbucketScopes: read repositories and pipelines, write pipelines

language.label: Language
language.description: Language of the interface, messages and built-in documentation. "System" follows your computer's language.

addRepository.title: Add a repository
addRepository.description: Track a repository that doesn't show up automatically: an open source project, or a repository of an organization you're not a member of.
addRepository.label: {{provider}} repository
addRepository.notConnected: No {{provider}} account connected: connect it first in Settings › Accounts.
addRepository.alreadyListed: This repository is already in your list.
addRepository.demoHint: In demo mode only fictitious repositories are available. Connect your accounts to track your real repositories.
addRepository.hint: Repositories your accounts can access are already added automatically. For a private repository, your credentials must have access to it.

dialog.title: New version available
dialog.available: Easy CI {{latest}} is available — you are using version {{current}}.
dialog.paste: Paste the command in a terminal, then restart Easy CI. Your accounts and settings are kept.
dialog.pasteWindows: Paste the command in a PowerShell terminal, then restart Easy CI. Your accounts and settings are kept.
dialog.manual: Download the new version from the release page and replace the old one.

logs.followOn: The log scrolls automatically. Scroll up to pause it.

overview.noFailure: No failure in the latest run of your workflows.
overview.noRunsDescription: As soon as a pipeline runs on one of your repositories, it will show up here.

palette.label: Command palette
palette.placeholder: Search a repository, a page, an action…

shell.favoritesEmpty: Star repositories to find them here.

repos.intro: Every repository your accounts can access is added automatically, with its CI/CD pipelines.
repos.noneAccessibleDescription: Your token gives access to no repository. Check its scopes (repo, read:org) or add a repository manually.
repos.noMatchQuery: No results for "{{query}}" with this filter.
repos.untrackDescription: It will no longer appear in Easy CI
repos.hideDescription: Can be shown again from settings

noCi.title: No {{ci}} pipeline
noCi.description: This repository has no configuration yet ({{config}}). The wizard analyzes your local clone and generates a pipeline suited to its stack.

repo.noFilesDescription: This repository's configuration is managed outside the repository (template or remote file).
repo.editTooltip: Edit in the local clone, then commit and propose it when you decide
repo.editNeedsLink: Changes are made in the local clone: link a folder first.

run.waitingJobsDescription: The platform is preparing the run.
run.rerunFailedDescription: Only failed jobs and the jobs that depend on them
run.noExplicitError: No explicit error message: here are the last log lines before it stopped.
run.noAnnotation: No annotation, check the log excerpt.
run.allowFailureTooltip: Allowed to fail: this job failed but does not block the pipeline.
run.jobSkippedDescription: This job did not run, usually because a job it depends on failed or its rules did not apply.
run.jobCancelledDescription: The run was cancelled before this job started.
run.waitingRunnerDescription: The job will start as soon as a runner is available or its dependencies have finished.
run.liveStepsHint: Steps update live. {{provider}} only publishes the full log at the end of the job: it will show up here automatically.

editor.linkFirstDescription: Easy CI edits CI files in this repository's clone on your machine: link an existing folder or clone the repository.
editor.savedWithErrors_one: {{count}} validation error to fix before committing.
editor.savedWithErrors_other: {{count}} validation errors to fix before committing.
editor.confirmSwitch: Some changes are not saved. Switch file anyway?
editor.generateTooltip: Generate a pipeline with the wizard

conflict.title: File changed elsewhere
conflict.description: "{{path}}" changed on disk since it was opened (another editor, git pull…).

confirmRestore.deleteDescription: This file was never committed: it will be deleted from the local folder. This cannot be undone.
confirmRestore.restoreDescription: Saved but uncommitted changes to this file will be lost. This cannot be undone.

leave.title: Unsaved changes
leave.description: Your changes to "{{path}}" are not written to the local folder yet.

editor.blocked_many: This file contains {{count}} validation errors: the pipeline may fail as soon as it starts.

validation.gitlabDescription: Sends the content to GitLab's CI Lint tool, which resolves "include" and "extends". The repository is not modified.

diff.intro: Differences between the remote branch{{ref}} and the saved file in the local folder.
diff.saveToInclude: Save to include your latest changes.
diff.newFile: New file: save it to compare.

editor.newWorkflowDescription: A file is created in .github/workflows from a minimal template, to be completed.
editor.fixYamlForSummary: Fix the YAML errors to show the overview.

commit.title: Commit locally
commit.description: The commit is created in your clone. Nothing is sent to the server at this step.
commit.noFiles: No modified CI file: save your changes first.
commit.onDefault: You are on the default branch ({{branch}}). A dedicated branch lets you propose the change as a pull request.

push.title: Push the branch
push.description: This publishes your local commits to the Git server.
push.newBranch: New branch: it will be created on the server, with all its commits.
push.dirty: Uncommitted changes stay on your machine and are not pushed.

pr.defaultBody:
CI configuration change proposed from Easy CI.

- Branch: {{branch}}
pr.title: Create a {{kind}}

card.onDefault: On the default branch: nothing to propose

generate.linkFirstDescription: The wizard analyzes the files of your clone (package.json, pyproject.toml, go.mod…) and writes the generated pipeline there: link an existing folder or clone the repository.
generate.written: Pipeline written to the local folder
generate.writtenDescription: Review it in the editor, then commit when you're happy with it.
generate.conflictDescription: The preview was refreshed: check it before trying again.
generate.title: Generate a {{ci}} pipeline
generate.subtitle: Deterministic templates, no AI: the file is written to your local clone, then you review and commit it.

analyse.title: What your project contains
analyse.description: Detected from the files of the local clone, without running anything. Turn a stack off to exclude it from the pipeline.
analyse.noStackDescription: Easy CI recognizes Node.js, Python, Go, Rust, Java/Kotlin, Android, PHP, Ruby and .NET. You can still generate a skeleton and add your commands in the editor.
analyse.dockerFound: {{file}} found. Image build can be enabled in the Delivery step.
analyse.dockerFoundCompose: {{file}} found, with a Compose file. Image build can be enabled in the Delivery step.
analyse.existingCi: This project already has a CI configuration:
analyse.existingCiNote: The generated file is added to it, or replaces it if it has the same name (you'll be asked to confirm).

stepsStep.title: Steps to run
stepsStep.description: Commands prefilled from your scripts and configuration files. Edit them freely: the preview updates live.
stepsStep.noStack: No stack included: the pipeline will contain an example job to complete.
stepsStep.cacheDescription: Reuses downloaded packages from one run to the next: much faster pipelines.
stepsStep.osDescription: Runs the tests on each selected system (useful for a cross-platform app or library).

triggers.title: When the pipeline runs
triggers.description: The usual triggers are already selected: every push to the default branch and every proposed change.
triggers.tagsDescription: For example v1.4.0: useful to publish a release.
triggers.scheduleExternal: The schedule is then created in the platform's interface (explained in the notes).
triggers.concurrencyDescription: A new push to the same branch interrupts the previous run, which is no longer useful.
triggers.fileGithub: A GitHub repository can contain several workflows.

delivery.title: Docker image and deployment
delivery.description: Optional. These jobs only run after the checks succeed, and only on the default branch or the selected tags.
delivery.noDockerfile: No Dockerfile detected: add one before enabling this job.
delivery.deployDescription: Runs your deployment command in a dedicated environment.
delivery.manualOther: button to click on the platform
delivery.useStackDescription: Prepare the {{stack}} environment (runtime and dependencies) before the command

review.title: Review before writing
review.description: The file will be written to your local folder. Nothing is committed or sent to {{provider}} at this step.
review.descriptionBranch: The file will be written to your local folder, on branch {{branch}}. Nothing is committed or sent to {{provider}} at this step.
review.errors_one: Validation reports {{count}} error: check the commands and paths you entered.
review.errors_other: Validation reports {{count}} errors: check the commands and paths you entered.
review.exists: {{path}} already exists in the local folder: it will be replaced. The previous version can be recovered with "Restore" in the editor as long as you haven't committed.
review.nextDescription: Review in the editor, commit on a local branch, then push and open a pull request only when you decide.
review.errors_many: Validation reports {{count}} errors: check the commands and paths you entered.

settings.intro: Customize Easy CI and manage your GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket accounts.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.themeDescription: Follow the system or force a light or dark theme.

sync.title: Synchronization
sync.refreshDescription: How often repositories are checked. Running pipelines are always followed every few seconds.
sync.showNoCiDescription: Repositories without a workflow stay visible, at the end of the list.
sync.archivedDescription: Archived repositories can no longer run workflows.

about.title: About
about.description: Monitor, fix, edit and generate your GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD and Bitbucket Pipelines from a single app. Free software released under the MIT license.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.demoDescription: The repositories shown are fictitious. Leave the demo to connect your GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket accounts.
accounts.keychainTooltip: Stored in the system's secure keychain: you stay signed in between launches.
accounts.sessionTooltip: Keychain unavailable: credentials kept for this session only.
accounts.connectDescription: Credentials are verified with the platform, then stored in the system keychain.

local.title: Local projects
local.gitDescription: Easy CI uses the Git installed on your machine, with your usual credentials and configuration.
local.gitMissingDescription: Install Git (https://git-scm.com), then restart Easy CI to use local projects.
local.rootsDescription: Easy CI looks for your Git clones there (up to 6 levels deep, excluding node_modules, .venv…) and links them to your repositories.
local.unmatchedTooltip: Clones whose remotes match no tracked repository:
local.autoFetchDescription: Regularly queries the Git server of each linked project (git fetch), without touching your files.
local.autoPullDescription: After each fetch, fast-forwards the local branch if it is behind. Never when there are uncommitted changes or unpushed local commits.

tracked.title: Tracked repositories
tracked.discoveryDescription: Easy CI tracks every repository your accounts can access: your own, and those of your organizations, groups and workspaces. A repository is missing? Check the platform token's scopes.
tracked.addedDescription: Repositories tracked in addition to automatic discovery.
tracked.hiddenDescription: Automatically discovered repositories you chose not to display.
tracked.hiddenEmpty: No hidden repository. Use a repository's "⋯" menu to hide it.

updates.title: Updates
updates.autoDescription: Queries GitHub at startup and every 6 hours to know whether a newer version is published. No personal data is sent.
updates.skippedDescription: No dialog is shown for this version. Later versions will be reported.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.enabledDescription: Lets you know when a watched pipeline fails or recovers. In the app a message appears; when the window is in the background, the system shows a notification.
notifications.failuresDescription: When the latest run of a workflow fails while it was green.
notifications.recoveriesDescription: When a failing workflow passes again.
notifications.scopeDescription: All displayed repositories, or only your favorites.
notifications.testDescription: Sends a test notification to check that it appears.
notifications.unsupported: Desktop notifications are not available here
notifications.unsupportedDescription: No notification service found (on Linux, install libnotify: notify-send). In-app messages are still shown.

method.osascript: macOS Notification Center, shown as “Script Editor”: if nothing appears, allow it in System Settings › Notifications

notifications.background: Repositories keep refreshing while the window is minimized, so no change is missed.

docs.title: Easy CI user guide
docs.intro: From connecting GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket to diagnosing a failing pipeline: everything you need to get the most out of the app.

test.title: Easy CI notifications are on
test.body: You will be notified when a watched pipeline fails or recovers.

empty.title: No statistics yet
empty.description: No completed runs for these filters. Statistics will appear after the next runs.

stats.footnote_other: Based on the last {{count}} completed runs. A job is unstable when it failed then passed on the same commit (retry), or when it often alternates between success and failure.
stats.incomplete_one: Jobs of one run could not be loaded.
stats.incomplete_other: Jobs of {{count}} runs could not be loaded.
stats.p90Hint: 9 runs out of 10 are faster · max {{value}}
stats.unstableHint: Worth a look: see the jobs table
stats.noJobs: No jobs analysed for these runs.

reasons.retried_one: Failed then passed on the same commit ({{count}} time): probably a flaky test.
reasons.retried_other: Failed then passed on the same commit ({{count}} times): probably a flaky test.
reasons.alternating_one: Often alternates between success and failure ({{count}} change).
reasons.alternating_other: Often alternates between success and failure ({{count}} changes).
